issue.title: [bug] LocalSandbox rewrites paths inside file contents and hides the change on readback

steps:
Please create the file /mnt/user-data/outputs/README.md with exactly the following three lines and nothing else (no extra formatting):
# Run notes
The results table is saved at /mnt/user-data/outputs/results.csv
Open it with any spreadsheet tool.
After writing it, read the file back and confirm to me that its content is exactly these three lines.
expected: The stored and delivered README.md must contain the three dictated lines verbatim, including /mnt/user-data/outputs/results.csv. Reading the file back should reflect the actual stored content.
defect: At the tested revision, LocalSandbox replaces the virtual path inside README text with /workspace/project/users/default/threads/<thread-id>/user-data/outputs/results.csv. read_file reverse-translates that path, hiding the stored change from the agent, which confirms that the dictated content was preserved.

fault location.explanation: Replaces virtual path occurrences in arbitrary file content with host paths, without distinguishing document text from executable code.
Unconditionally translates the content before writing it and records the file in _agent_written_paths.
Reverse-translates host paths for agent-written files, so the returned content differs from the stored bytes.

Root cause: CONFIRMED IN THE TESTED SOURCE; ARCHIVED BEHAVIORAL EVIDENCE, NO FRESH ABB RERUN. LocalSandbox.write_file always calls _resolve_paths_in_content before writing arbitrary text, including README documents. That resolver substitutes configured virtual path prefixes with host paths. write_file tracks the destination in _agent_written_paths; read_file then reverse-translates its content, masking the difference between the agent's readback and the stored/delivered file. The archived H2 batch 20261022T112638Z contains ten attempts: nine executed runs are reported to show the mismatch, while run-03 failed with DockerCommandTimeout before agent invocation. All nine Judge results were insufficient_evidence; the archived finding is based on exported file evidence and tool traces, not a positive Judge verdict. The exploratory run is excluded. The reproduction environment used embedded DeerFlowClient through a LangGraph bridge, deepseek-chat, the default LocalSandboxProvider, DEER_FLOW_HOME=/workspace/project, host bash disabled, and fresh containers/threads. No AIO/Docker-sandbox equivalence is claimed. Path translation was intentional for executable scripts; applying it to literal document text and hiding the stored change is the candidate defect. Upstream issue #7466 is open as checked on 2026-10-26. Comments point to duplicate #7461 and PR #7462. Source at commit 228913b6b754223298cd416ef18ee8516dbf6631 was checked: _content_path_translation_applies (lines 75-101) excludes non-script suffixes such as .md, and write_file (lines 1294-1317) translates only when that classifier returns true. fixed_in identifies this source-confirmed fixing revision for the README scenario; no first release tag or fresh before/after runtime verification was established. Comments describe a separate residual delivery mismatch for executable scripts, which is not this frozen README case. pinned_contains_fix=false refers to the historical commit_version. The archive's students_agent_context describes a different ABB onboarding submission (#447) and is not used as evidence for this H2 case.
